Wisconsin now will play Duke in the final at the Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis on Monday night. Duke had already beaten Michigan State, 81-61, in the earlier semi-final.

Cambiasso refuses to give up and admits that keeping Leicester up will feel like winning a trophy. He told BBC East Midlands Today: “For me, it’s like another cup.”

 Guardiola said at his press conference: "Schweinsteiger will not be match fit in time." He also shouted instructions to his players against Borussia Dortmund.
